name: Do not tumble dry
why: Heat shrinks natural fibres and weakens elastane, so stretch pieces lose their shape.

name: Rinse, dry and polish (latex)
why: Sweat and oils break latex down; rinsing it in lukewarm water and storing it polished, away from light and metal, makes it last years.

name: Wash inside out
why: Protects prints, dark dyes and surface finishes from rubbing in the drum.
